              (Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.add_lt_of_le_of_neg (Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.sub_nonpos_of_le h)
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.sub_neg_of_lt a))))
  else
    have h1 :=
      Fin.ext
        (have hn := fun h => hl (Fin.ext h);
        have hb := lam.isLt;
        id (Decidable.byContradiction fun a => AnvBandit.ActualNodeExpectation.goodLoss_node._proof_1_1 lam hn hb a));
    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun lam =>
      ¬lam = 0 →
        AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c ≤
          M.supOthers c *
              AnvBandit.Abeta
                (have this := p.hn;
                Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                  AnvBandit.ActualNodeExpectation.integrate_node_bound._proof_1✝ this a)
                C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) (↑p.H) (↑(AnvBandit.ActualPropagation.preparation M p)) p.β
                ↑p.T +
            M.Clam c p.L
              (AnvBandit.DP
                (have this := p.hn;
                Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                  AnvBandit.ActualNodeExpectation.integrate_node_bound._proof_1✝ this a)
                p.hn C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star))
              lam)
      (fun hl => AnvBandit.ActualNodeExpectation.goodLoss_node_public_min M p C c hc hstar) (Eq.symm h1) hl
theorem AnvBandit.Absorbing.weighted_loss_potential_branch : ∀ {n K : ℕ} (M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K)
  (p : AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (lam : Fin 2) (c : Fin K → ℝ),
  (∀ (k : Fin K), 0 ≤ c k) →
    c M.star = 0 →
      AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c ≤
        M.Flam c p.L lam +
          M.supOthers c *
            (2 * AnvBandit.M1 ⋯ C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) *
                M.Flam (AnvBandit.Absorbing.unitCost M) p.L lam +
              AnvBandit.concreteKbeta ⋯ C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) (↑p.H) p.β
                (AnvBandit.ActualPropagation.preparation M p)) :=
fun {n K} M p C lam c hc hstar =>
  let hd :=
    have this := p.hn;
    Decidable.byContradiction fun a => AnvBandit.Absorbing.missing_drift_budget._proof_1 this a;
  have hm := id (Finset.sum_nonneg fun x x_1 => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg);
  have hdlen := fun ℓ =>
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 ≤ _a) (Eq.symm (AnvBandit.Execution.Params.phaseLength_cast p ℓ))))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg' (p.phaseEnd ℓ - p.phaseEnd (ℓ - 1)));
  AnvBandit.lemma_C_3 M c p.L lam p.T (AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β)
    (fun ℓ => AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedPotential M p C lam (ℓ - 1))
    (AnvBandit.M1 hd C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star))
    (AnvBandit.concreteKbeta hd C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) (↑p.H) p.β
      (AnvBandit.ActualPropagation.preparation M p))
    (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c) hc hm
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                  (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑p.H)
                    (congrArg Nat.cast
                      (congrArg Nat.ceil (congrFun' (congrArg HPow.hPow (CharP.cast_eq_zero ℝ 0)) p.β)))))
                (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑p.H)
                  (congrArg Nat.cast
                    (congrArg Nat.ceil
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg HPow.hPow (Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.cast (zero_tsub 1)) (CharP.cast_eq_zero ℝ 0)))
                        p.β)))))
              (sub_self (↑p.H * ↑⌈0 ^ p.β⌉₊))))
          0)
        (eq_self 0)))
    hdlen (fun ℓ => AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedPotential_nonneg M p C lam (ℓ - 1))
    (have h0 := AnvBandit.Absorbing.goodLoss_le_exploration_phases M p C lam c hc hstar;
    have hmax := LE.le.trans (hc M.star) (AnvBandit.Absorbing.cost_le_supOthers M c hc hstar M.star);
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (AnvBandit.Absorbing.missing_drift_budget M p C lam p.T) hmax;
    have hnorm := fun j =>
      Decidable.byContradiction fun a => AnvBandit.Absorbing.weighted_loss_potential_branch._proof_1_1 j a;
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (LE.le (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c))
          (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd (M.Flam c p.L lam))
            (congrArg (HMul.hMul (M.supOthers c))
              (congrArg
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (2 * AnvBandit.M1 hd C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) *
                    M.Flam (fun k => if k = M.star then 0 else 1) p.L lam))
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl (Finset.range p.T)) fun x a =>
                  congrArg (HMul.hMul (AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β (x + 1)))
                    (congr
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                        (congrArg (AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedPotential M p C lam) (Nat.add_sub_cancel x 1)))
                      (congrArg (AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedPotential M p C lam) ((fun j => hnorm j) x)))))))))
      (id
        (le_of_not_gt fun a =>
          Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.lt_irrefl
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a < 0)
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_congr
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c) rfl
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                    AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                (Eq.symm rfl)))
                            (Eq.refl (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (M.Flam c p.L lam) rfl
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    M.Flam c p.L lam ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                      M.Flam c p.L lam ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                  (Eq.symm rfl)))
                              (Eq.refl (M.Flam c p.L lam ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_congr
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (M.supOthers c) rfl
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      M.supOthers c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                        M.supOthers c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                    (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                (Eq.refl (M.supOthers c ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf
                              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range p.T,
                                AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β (j + 1) * AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedMissing M p C lam j)
                              rfl
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range p.T,
                                              AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β (j + 1) *
                                                AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedMissing M p C lam j) ^
                                            Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                          Nat.rawCast 1 =
                                        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range p.T,
                                              AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β (j + 1) *
                                                AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedMissing M p C lam j) ^
                                            Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                          _a)
                                    (Eq.symm rfl)))
                                (Eq.refl
                                  ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range p.T,
                                        AnvBandit.dEll (↑p.H) p.β (j + 1) *
                                          AnvBandit.Absorbing.expectedMissing M p C lam j) ^
                                      Nat.rawCast 1 *
                                    Nat.rawCast 1))))
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_mul
                              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_add
                                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_left (M.supOthers c) (Nat.rawCast 1)
                                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.mul_pf_right

theorem AnvBandit.concreteKbeta_summable : ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (i0 : Fin n)
  {H β : ℝ},
  0 ≤ H →
    1 < β → ∀ (r : ℕ), Summable fun ℓ => AnvBandit.scheduleOmega H β (ℓ + 1) * AnvBandit.remainingV ⋯ C i0 (ℓ - r) :=
fun {n} hn C i0 {H β} hH hβ r =>
  have hd :=
    have this := cast (Eq.symm Nat.cast_le._simp_1) hn;
    lt_of_not_ge fun a =>
      Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.lt_irrefl
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a < 0)
            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
              (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.cast_pos (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one))

                      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt.to_raw_eq
                        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isInt_neg (Eq.refl Neg.neg)
                          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isInt (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℝ 1))
                          (Eq.refl (Int.negOfNat 1))))
                      Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_zero))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.cast_pos (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑n) rfl
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => ↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = ↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                            (Eq.symm rfl)))
                        (Eq.refl (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_pf
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_add
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_mul (↑n) (Nat.rawCast 1)
                          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt.to_raw_eq
                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isInt_neg (Eq.refl Neg.neg)
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isInt (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℝ 1))
                              (Eq.refl (Int.negOfNat 1)))))
                        Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_zero)
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_lt (Nat.rawCast 2)
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_zero_add
                          (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (Int.negOfNat 1).rawCast + 0)))))
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_add_overlap

                      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt.to_isNat
                        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isInt_add (Eq.refl HAdd.hAdd)

                          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isInt (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℝ 2))
                          (Eq.refl (Int.ofNat 1)))))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_pf_zero_add (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * (Int.negOfNat 1).rawCast + 0))))
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_congr
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑n) rfl
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id

                        (Eq.refl (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.cast_pos (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one))
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_pf
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_add

            (Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.sub_nonpos_of_le a)));
  AnvBandit.Kbeta_summable
    (mul_nonneg
      (le_of_lt
        (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2))))

def AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.cooperativeBound : {n K : ℕ} →
  AnvBandit.DecayModel n K → AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K → AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n → Fin 2 → ℝ :=
fun {n K} M p C lam =>
  AnvBandit.Uco (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑n ↑p.T) (M.Gamma lam)
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T)
    (AnvBandit.Main.actualEcost M p C lam (M.rho p.T lam))
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T))
def AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.independentBound : {n K : ℕ} →
  AnvBandit.DecayModel n K → AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K → Fin 2 → ℝ :=
fun {n K} M p lam =>
  AnvBandit.Uind (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑n ↑p.T) (M.Gamma lam)
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T) (M.Flam (M.rho p.T lam) p.L lam)
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T))
theorem AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.corollary_4_2 : ∀ {n K : ℕ} (M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K)
  (p : AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (lam : Fin 2),
  LT.lt.{0} (AnvBandit.Main.actualEcost M p C lam (M.rho p.T lam)) (M.Flam (M.rho p.T lam) p.L lam) →
    LT.lt.{0}
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (AnvBandit.Main.actualEcost M p C lam (M.rho p.T lam))
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T)))
        (min.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) (M.supOthers (M.rho p.T lam))) ↑p.T)
          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑n ↑p.T) (M.Gamma lam))) →
      LE.le.{0} (AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.teamRegret M p C lam)
          (AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.cooperativeBound M p C lam) ∧
        LE.le.{0} (AnvBandit.BaselineTrajectory.teamRegret M p lam)
            (AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.independentBound M p lam) ∧
          LT.lt.{0} (AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.cooperativeBound M p C lam)
            (AnvBandit.BaselineComparison.independentBound M p lam) :=
⋯

fun {n} {P} hP i0 =>
  have hex := ⋯;
  let rk := fun v => Nat.find ⋯;
  have rk_spec := ⋯;
  have rk_min := ⋯;
  have hrank_i0 := ⋯;
  have hrank_zero := ⋯;
  have hparent := ⋯;
  { rank := rk, rank_i0 := hrank_i0, rank_eq_zero := hrank_zero, rank_le := ⋯,
    parent := fun v => if hv : Eq.{1} v i0 then i0 else Classical.choose.{1} ⋯, edge_pos := ⋯, parent_lt := ⋯ }

theorem AnvBandit.terminal_budget : ∀ {n K : ℕ} {M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K},
  LT.lt.{0} 0 n →
    ∀ (c : Fin K → ℝ) (L : ℝ),

            Membership.mem.{0, 0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i0) M.star →
              (∀ (i : Fin n), Membership.mem.{0, 0} J i → Disjoint.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)) →
                (∀ (i : Fin n), Membership.mem.{0, 0} J i → LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{0} (D i)) 2) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n),
                      Membership.mem.{0, 0} J i →
                        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)) M.star) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        Membership.mem.{0, 0} J i →
                          LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{0} (Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)))
                            (AnvBandit.smax n K)) →
                      LE.le.{0}
                        (∑ i ∈ J,
                          ∑ k ∈ Finset.erase.{0} (Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)) M.star, M.wk c L k)
                        (M.Ccap c L) :=
⋯

        (∀ (i : Fin n), Disjoint.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)) →
          (∀ (i : Fin n), LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{0} (D i)) 2) →
            (∀ (i : Fin n), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i)) M.star) →
              (∀ (i : Fin n),
                  LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{0} (Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i))) (AnvBandit.smax n K)) →
                (∀ (t : ℕ) (i : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0} (arr i) t → LT.lt.{0} t T → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (R.active t i) M.star) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n),
                      LE.le.{0}
                        (Finset.card.{0}
                          {k |
                            k ∉ Union.union.{0} (AnvBandit.permSet n K i) (D i) ∧
                              ∃ t, Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Finset.range T) t ∧ LE.le.{0} (arr i) t ∧ Eq.{1} (R.I t i) k})
                        (elim i)) →
                    LE.le.{0} (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ∑ i, c (R.I t i))
                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (M.supOthers c) ↑(∑ i, min.{0} T (arr i)))
                          (M.Ccap c R.L))

def AnvBandit.DecayModel.ofPositiveCurves : {n K : ℕ} →
  (b : Fin K → ℝ) →
    (f : Fin K → ℕ → ℝ) →
      (star : Fin K) →
        (∀ (k : Fin K), LT.lt.{0} 0 (b k)) →
          (∀ (k : Fin K), LE.le.{0} (b k) 1) →
            (∀ (k : Fin K) (s : ℕ), LE.le.{0} 1 s → LE.le.{0} 0 (f k s)) →
              (∀ (k : Fin K) (s t : ℕ), LE.le.{0} 1 s → LE.le.{0} s t → LE.le.{0} (f k t) (f k s)) →
                (∀ (k : Fin K), Filter.Tendsto.{0, 0} (f k) Filter.atTop.{0} (nhds.{0} 0)) →
                  (∀ (k : Fin K) (s : ℕ), LE.le.{0} 1 s → LE.le.{0} (f k s) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} 1 (b k))) →
                    (∀ (k : Fin K), LE.le.{0} (b k) (b star)) →
                      (∀ (k : Fin K), Eq.{1} (b k) (b star) → Eq.{1} k star) →
                        LE.le.{0} 2 n → LE.le.{0} 2 K → AnvBandit.DecayModel n K :=
fun {n K} b f star b_pos b_le_one f_nonneg f_anti f_tendsto f_le_gap b_le_star star_unique two_le_n two_le_K =>
  { b := b, f := fun k => AnvBandit.extendPositiveCurve (f k), star := star, b_pos := b_pos, b_le_one := b_le_one,
    f_nonneg := ⋯, f_anti := ⋯, f_tendsto := ⋯, f_le_gap := ⋯, b_le_star := b_le_star, star_unique := star_unique,
    two_le_n := two_le_n, two_le_K := two_le_K }

            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) (AnvBandit.ActualWaiting.expectedWaiting M p C lam))
            (M.Clam c p.L 0 lam)) :=
⋯
theorem AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.weightedLoss_le_goodLoss_add_failure : ∀ {n K : ℕ} (M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K)
  (p : AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (lam : Fin 2) (c : Fin K → ℝ) (cmax : ℝ),

    (∀ (k : Fin K), LE.le.{0} (c k) cmax) →
      LE.le.{0} (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.weightedLoss M p C lam c)
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (AnvBandit.GlobalRegret.goodLoss M p C lam c)
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) ↑p.T))) :=
⋯
theorem AnvBandit.GlobalTheorem.team_regret_global_bound : ∀ {n K : ℕ} (M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K)
  (p : AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (lam : Fin 2),
  have c := M.rho p.T lam;
  have cmax := M.supOthers c;
  have Pbar :=
    min.{0} (↑p.T)
      (AnvBandit.Pbeta ⋯ C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) (↑p.H) (↑(AnvBandit.ActualPropagation.preparation M p))
        p.β);
  LE.le.{0} (AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.teamRegret M p C lam)
    (min.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑n ↑p.T)
      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (M.Gamma lam)
        (min.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) ↑p.T)
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) Pbar) (M.Clam c p.L 0 lam))
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) ↑p.T)))))) :=
⋯

def AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.oracle : {n K : ℕ} → AnvBandit.DecayModel n K → ℕ → Fin 2 → ℝ :=
fun {n K} M T lam => ite.{1} (Eq.{1} lam 0) (AnvBandit.Vstar0 M) (AnvBandit.Vstar1 M)
def AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.pathReward : {n K : ℕ} →
  AnvBandit.DecayModel n K → AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K → Fin 2 → AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.Path n → ℝ :=
fun {n K} M p lam ω =>
  AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.jointValue M lam (AnvBandit.TrajectoryExpectation.pathActions p ω)
theorem AnvBandit.ObservedRegret.original_team_regret_global_bound : ∀ {n K : ℕ} (M : AnvBandit.DecayModel n K)
  (p : AnvBandit.Execution.Params n K) (C : AnvBandit.ContactMatrix n) (lam : Fin 2)
  (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure.{0} (AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.Path n)) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.{0} ν],
  Eq.{1} (MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{0, 0} (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} 0) ν)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{0, 0} (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} 0)
        (AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.observedMeasure M p C lam)) →
    (∀ (t : ℕ),
        LT.lt.{0} t p.T →
          ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib.{0, 0, 0} (fun ω => (ω (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1)).1)
                (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} t)
                ν) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{0, 0} (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} t) ν]
            ⇑(AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.rewardKernel M p lam t)) →
      (∀ (t : ℕ),
          LT.lt.{0} t p.T →
            AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.retainedContact p (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1) →
              ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.condDistrib.{0, 0, 0} (fun ω => (ω (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1)).2)
                    (fun ω => Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} t ω) (ω (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1)).1)
                    ν) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{0, 0}
                  (fun ω => Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Preorder.frestrictLe.{0, 0} t ω) (ω (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1)).1) ν]
                ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const.{0, 0} (Prod.{0, 0} (AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.Prefix n t) (Fin n → Bool))
                    (PMF.toMeasure.{0} (AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.contactDistribution C)))) →
        (∀ (t : ℕ),
            LT.lt.{0} t p.T →
              ¬AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.retainedContact p (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1) →
                ∀ᵐ (ω : AnvBandit.ExecutionLaw.Path n) ∂ν, Eq.{1} (ω (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t 1)).2 id.{1}) →
          have c := M.rho p.T lam;
          have cmax := M.supOthers c;
          have Pbar :=
            min.{0} (↑p.T)
              (AnvBandit.Pbeta ⋯ C (AnvBandit.Execution.holder p M.star) (↑p.H)
                (↑(AnvBandit.ActualPropagation.preparation M p)) p.β);
          LE.le.{0} (AnvBandit.ObservedRegret.originalTeamRegret M p lam ν)
            (min.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑n ↑p.T)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (M.Gamma lam)
                (min.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) ↑p.T)
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) Pbar)
                      (M.Clam c p.L 0 lam))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} p.δ (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) cmax) ↑p.T)))))) :=
